purpose: Student-controlled printable practice assembled locally from QA-approved pre-authored practice-pool items. The browser does not invent new mathematics.
hard_rules: Keep the student Practice Builder at Unit level immediately after Student Bank on student and teacher dashboards for preview access.
Student selects Unit, exact I Can statements, and questions per checked I Can; no Family A/B/C controls are exposed to students.
Questions-per-I-Can control uses integer choices 1-10. The selected number applies separately to every checked I Can, so total questions = checked I Cans x selected questions per I Can.
Question choices come only from an APPROVED + QA PASS banks/unitN/student_practice_pool.json for the selected Unit.

A production-ready Unit pool covers every exact I Can and every approved A/B/C family in the COMPLETE downstream-ready Unit Bank, with four pre-authored solved instances per family unless teacher instruction changes that count.
If a Unit pool is unavailable, not APPROVED / QA PASS, or lacks enough unique approved items for the requested questions per checked I Can, fail closed rather than generating questions live.
Generated questions are grouped by I Can statement.
Do not use a large toner-heavy page header in the generated worksheet.
Student workspace is blank whitespace: no bordered response boxes and no ruled workspace lines unless mathematically required.

Do not use html2pdf or separate Student/Answer Key PDF download buttons. Use the browser Print / Save PDF flow for the student copy and a simple Print / Save Answer Key link that prints only the answer-key view.

The browser may select and reorder approved instances only; it may not alter values, prompts, answers, or mathematical representations. A presentation-only MathJax delimiter repair may move accidental prose out of an inline-math span when meaning/content is unchanged; unresolved suspicious prose-in-math must fail closed.
The Unit dropdown may expose Units 1-8, but only a Unit with an approved pool becomes usable; future pools activate without redesigning the builder.

Support ?unit=N and optional ?ican=<exact I Can ID>. Multiple targets may be supplied by repeating ?ican= or by a comma-separated ican value so Portfolio routes can preselect targets without exposing student identity.
MathJax uses \( ... \) and \[ ... \] delimiters; currency remains literal text.

Before deployment, audit the final rendered builder HTML with Tools/fix_mathjax_output.py. Because practice pools are serialized JSON, do not run heuristic HTML rewriting directly on the JSON; validate student_html delimiter spans schema-aware and repair only defensible presentation defects.
Do not change this locked interaction/layout contract without explicit teacher instruction.
